title: StormBonk
description:
StormBonk is a constant‑motion arcade shmup where your ship never stops moving. Steer freely in four directions plus diagonals, boost to 2× speed when things get tight, and survive chaotic meteor storms while grabbing the correct numbers to solve fast math problems.

Every run mixes reflex‑based dodging, quick decision‑making, and explosive arcade action. Blast space junk, avoid incoming debris, and pick the right numbers before the storm overwhelms you. It’s simple to start and fast to play. StormBonk is fully keyboard‑controlled — pure directional arcade movement with no mouse required.

FEATURES

• Constant motion — your ship is always moving; you steer the chaos

• Free‑direction control — four directions + diagonals + optional 2× speed

• Keyboard‑only controls — pure arcade movement; no mouse needed

• Smooth dodging — slip through meteor storms you absolutely shouldn’t survive

• Math progression — grab the correct numbers to solve quick puzzles

• Number collecting — because the universe apparently runs on math and chaos

• Short, addictive runs — perfect for five‑minute breaks that somehow turn into an hour

• Meteor storms — dodge dense waves of cosmic junk

• High‑contrast visuals — bright explosions and clear silhouettes

• Pick‑up‑and‑play — easy to learn, hard to survive

StormBonk blends classic arcade chaos with a quirky math‑driven twist. Dodge, shoot, and solve your way through a storm that never stops trying to bonk you.
description_short: A constant‑motion arcade shmup where you dodge meteors, blast space junk, and solve quick math puzzles — all with pure keyboard controls.
